item.title: North Bay police looking for 62-year-old Pierre who has been reported missing
item.description: North Bay Police Service is looking for the public’s help in locating 62-year-old Pierre, who has been reported missing. Police didn’t provide a last name. He is described as 5’11, medium build, with black and grey hair past his shoulders and was last seen wearing a Harley Davidson T-shirt, blue jeans, blue ball cap and […]

item.title: Saint Joseph-Scollard Hall Bears capture bronze division title at Bur Bear hockey tournament
item.description: The SJSH Bears boys hockey team rolled through the opposition to win the bronze division never suffering a loss at the Bur Bear tournament in Burlington

item.title: North Bay Jack Garland Airport welcomes new non-stop WestJet Service to Calgary
item.description: According to WestJet's website, tickets can be purchased starting June 19. A one-way ticket is $129.34. Flights are scheduled twice a week. The last flight listed is Sept. 11.

item.title: What is happening to the former director of education at the Near North school board?
item.description: Will he have to pay back the extra salary that he gave himself over the years, including an increase of nearly 17% between 2023 and 2024 for a total of $300,000?
